name: City Upon A Hill
overview: In Matthew 5, Jesus teaches that believers are like a city set upon a hill, visible to all and impossible to hide, illustrating the call for Christians to be a shining light through their good works that glorify God. This imagery is reinforced by the metaphor of a candle placed on a candlestick, meant to give light to everyone in the house rather than being hidden under a bushel, emphasizing the public and active nature of faithful witness. The warning in Matthew 6:1 cautions believers to perform righteousness sincerely before God, not for human praise, underscoring that the light Christians display must be rooted in genuine devotion to the Father in heaven.
